hero.label: Made for PropRise
hero.headline: I want to be the SDR who helps PropRise own CRE.
hero.subheadline: PropRise is solving a real problem: institutional CRE teams are still running deals through clunky Excel workflows, and AI built specifically for that world is genuinely rare. I have hands-on experience building cold outreach from scratch and converting prospects into paying customers at an early-stage AI startup, and I want to bring that same energy to the team trusted by the people behind $50B+ in commercial real estate.

whyCompany.title: PropRise targets a massive, workflow-broken market ready for disruption
whyCompany.body: Institutional CRE acquisition teams are notoriously slow to adopt tech, which means the first platform to earn their trust wins big and keeps it. PropRise is not just selling software, it is selling time back to dealmakers who live and die by speed. That is a compelling story to tell in a cold email or a first call.

whyCompany.title: Three employees, YC-backed, and hiring a founding SDR right now
whyCompany.body: PropRise is at exactly the moment where the right SDR can shape the entire GTM playbook, not just execute someone else's. Working directly alongside Jean-Michael and Matthew means fast feedback loops, real ownership, and the kind of career-defining experience you cannot get at a 500-person company. This is the founding moment I have been looking for.

whyCompany.title: My BDR track record maps directly onto what PropRise needs at the top of funnel
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built cold outreach sequences from zero, managed prospects in HubSpot, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients for an early-stage AI product with no brand recognition. That is the exact muscle PropRise needs: someone who can generate pipeline in a skeptical market without leaning on an established name or a big sales team behind them.

quote: I spent over a year convincing skeptical buyers to trust an AI product nobody had heard of, and I loved every minute of it. PropRise is a harder and more exciting version of that challenge, and I want to be the person who cracks it open.
